page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a baseline frequency of 3.2 GHz.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, making it inappropriate for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning training workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.r9i.3xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high memory capacity relative to compute resources without the overhead of local storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This hardware profile is appropriate for memory-intensive applications, including medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that fit within the 96.0 GB memory envelope.
